The floating rate is then re-priced on each facility anniversary from year 2-4, depending on the initial fixed-rate tenor.</li>\n</ul>\n<p>The bank's margin structure can be adjusted based on feedback from the Business and Risk departments. These measures included amendments to the Prudential Regulations (PRs) for consumer financing. The goal was to moderate auto loans by increasing down payment requirements and reducing the maximum tenure of auto financing. Additionally, banks were required to obtain prior approval from the SBP when opening Letters of Credit (L/Cs) for 25 high-value capital goods, including Completely Knocked Down (CKD) cars.
